oral_examination.oral_examination: 38 Black caries were seen on the maxillary surface, and the crown of the tooth was fully erupted and tilted mesially. CBCT shows that the root apex is close to the mandibular neural canal. 37 CBCT showed that deep caries penetrated the pulp on the distal proximal surface, and the root tip was dark.

treatment_plan.definitive: 38 removal. 37 Root canal treatment and crown restoration are recommended.
treatment_plan.notes: Routine medical advice and follow-up consultation if any discomfort occurs. Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: 37 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, open the pulp, expand the medullary hole, explore the three canals, remove all the pulp, and measure the root length (distal 19mm, mesiobuccal 18mm mesiolingually 18mm), with the assistance of Glyde, WEVE-ONE System, mechanical nickel titanium, root canal preparation. Rinse with 5.25% NaClO and 0.9% NaLC alternately, rinse with ultrasonic waves, dry, seep blood from the root tip, and open with OC cotton wool. 38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, divide the gums, divide the roots, loosen, push out, and compress to stop bleeding.
